result.reason: The revision improves the duration to 90 days from acceptance and preserves the existing correction/replacement/refund structure, but it does not reach the full fallback. It omits a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty and a compliance-with-laws warranty, and the malicious-code warranty remains limited to code “willfully introduced,” rather than an unqualified no-malicious-code warranty. The narrow change preserves unrelated intent, but the clause also retains drafting defects, including subject-verb disagreement, an incomplete exception lead-in, and an orphaned disclaimer fragment.
